entries.title: Federal Reserve's two GENIUS Act payment-stablecoin proposed rules publish in the Federal Register; comments must be received by November 30, 2026
entries.facts: The Federal Register issue of September 29, 2026 carries both Federal Reserve Board notices of proposed rulemaking under the GENIUS Act. Document 2026-19860, "Implementing the Federal Reserve Board's Responsibilities Under the GENIUS Act" (Docket No. R-1899, RIN 7100-AH29, 12 CFR Parts 208, 211, 217, 225, 247 and 263), states: "Comments must be received by November 30, 2026." Its summary states that the Board "proposes to issue regulations to implement the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act) with respect to Board-supervised permitted payment stablecoin issuers (PPSIs) and certain other entities that are subject to the Board's jurisdiction." Document 2026-19899, "Application Procedures for Board-Supervised Insured Depository Institutions Seeking Approval for a Subsidiary To Issue Payment Stablecoins" (Docket No. R-1900, RIN 7100-AH30), states: "Comments must be received by the Board on or before November 30, 2026." Both documents carry the action "Notice of proposed rulemaking" and a publication date of September 29, 2026. The Board announced the two proposals on September 24, 2026, when both notices' date sections carried an unfilled placeholder in place of a calendar deadline.
entries.source_label: Federal Register - Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, notice of proposed rulemaking, Docket No. R-1899 (FR doc. 2026-19860)
entries.relevant_to: payment stablecoin issuers, banks and bank holding companies, firms safekeeping reserve assets, payments and fintech operators

entries.title: SEC publishes Cboe Exchange's immediately effective filing amending standard transaction fees for its Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index options (CBTX) and Mini Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index options (MBTX); comments due October 20, 2026
entries.facts: The Federal Register issue of September 29, 2026 carries SEC document 2026-19863, "Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Cboe Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index Options ('CBTX') and Cboe Mini Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index Options ('MBTX') Standard Transaction Fees," File No. SR-CBOE-2026-077. The notice states that "on September 15, 2026, Cboe Exchange, Inc. (the 'Exchange' or 'Cboe Options') filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the 'Commission') the proposed rule change," and that the "Exchange proposes to amend Cboe Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index options ('CBTX') and Cboe Mini Bitcoin U.S. ETF Index options ('MBTX') standard transaction fees." On comments the notice states: "All submissions should refer to file number SR-CBOE-2026-077 and should be submitted on or before October 20, 2026." The filing is published as a notice of filing and immediate effectiveness.
entries.source_label: Federal Register - U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, SRO notice, File No. SR-CBOE-2026-077 (FR doc. 2026-19863)
entries.relevant_to: options market makers, brokers and trading firms active in bitcoin ETF index options, crypto derivatives desks

entries.title: SEC publishes Cboe Clear U.S.'s application for a Section 36 exemption on the treatment of customer margin held for binary options under Rule 15c3-3; comments due October 20, 2026
entries.facts: The Federal Register issue of September 29, 2026 carries SEC document 2026-19916, "Notice of an Application of Cboe Clear U.S., LLC for an Exemption Pursuant to Section 36 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Regarding the Treatment of Customer Margin Under Item 13 and Note F of Exhibit A to Rule 15c3-3." The notice states that "CCUS is requesting exemptive relief on behalf of broker-dealers that are CCUS clearing members ('Clearing Members') from the limitation in Item 13 and Note F of Exhibit A to Rule 15c3-3," and that the relief concerns "margin that is required and on deposit at CCUS for binary options that are cleared by CCUS." On comments the notice states: "Comments should be received on or before October 20, 2026."
entries.source_label: Federal Register - U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, notice of application of Cboe Clear U.S., LLC (FR doc. 2026-19916)
entries.relevant_to: clearing members and broker-dealers carrying binary-options positions, clearing agencies, market-infrastructure operators
